data.name: EZY Virtual TableTop Builder
data.detailed_description:
EZY VTT is a no-code builder for tabletop roleplaying games: build your own game, then play it, all in one place.

Most virtual tabletops force someone else's rules on you. EZY VTT works the other way around: you visually create your own system — character sheets, dice mechanics, combat, inventory, everything your rules need — with no programming and no formulas. Then you invite players to a live 2D or 3D tabletop and run a session where everything is already set up and working.

Any system, built visually
Assemble character sheets block by block: attributes, skills, inventory, trackers, custom widgets — all with drag-and-drop, no code. Configure dice rolls, success conditions, and derived stats through a visual logic editor. Whether you want to recreate a classic system or invent one entirely your own, EZY VTT adapts to your game, not the other way around.

A true 2D/3D tabletop
Switch freely between a classic 2D grid and a full 3D tabletop with dice physics. Build multi-level locations with a working elevator between floors. Draw walls and line of sight, reveal the fog of war as players explore the map, measure distances, drop pings on the map, and hand out notes and images right in the middle of a session.

Deep automation without the busywork
Set up triggers, conditions, and effects visually — damage is applied automatically, statuses expire on schedule, items grant passive bonuses, and NPCs react to combat. As much automation as your table actually needs — while players still roll their own dice.

A living library
Create your own modules from scratch or download modules from other authors and open them in the same visual editor — rework them, expand them, make them your own. Every module is fully editable, and authors can share their work, sell it, or keep it private.

Make your table your own
Create custom dice — with their own materials, symbols, and glow — and custom cursors with trails. Everyone else at the table sees them too, so your character's presence shows in every roll and every movement.

Built for real sessions
Networked multiplayer with game master and player roles, an initiative tracker with multiple styles, a bestiary and NPC builder, shops and item libraries, ambient music and sound effects controlled by the game master, and a full marketplace for sharing modules with the community.

Features

  • No-code visual builder for sheets and rules

  • 2D and 3D tabletop you can switch between at any time

  • Multi-level maps with elevator navigation

  • Fog of war, line of sight, walls

  • Visual automation and logic graphs

  • Custom dice and cosmetic cursors, visible to everyone at the table

  • Bestiary and NPC builder, shops, item libraries

  • Import, edit, and rework modules from other authors

  • Live ambient music, sound effects, and playlists

  • Real-time networked sessions, cross-platform

data.short_description: A no-code virtual tabletop and TTRPG builder. Create your own character sheets and game mechanics without writing code, run sessions on 2D and 3D tabletops with fog of war and multi-level maps, play online with friends, and download, customize, and expand community-made modules.
data.supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Indonesian, Polish, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit (version 1809+) or Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 / AMD Ryzen 3 (dual-core, 2 GHz+)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 620 / any GPU with WebGL2 support
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Standard Windows-compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: Broadband internet connection required
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 / AMD Ryzen 5 (quad-core)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Any dedicated GPU (NVIDIA GTX 1050 / AMD RX 560 or better)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Standard Windows-compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: Broadband internet connection required

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS 64-bit or newer (Debian 12+, Fedora 36+, SteamOS 3)
  • Processor: Dual-core, 2.0 GHz, x86-64
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.3 / WebGL2 capable (integrated Intel HD 5000+ is fine)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any (ALSA / PulseAudio)
  • Additional Notes: Requires WebKitGTK 4.1 (libwebkit2gtk-4.1-0) and GTK 3. Included by default in Ubuntu 22.04+, Debian 12+, Fedora 36+, Arch and SteamOS 3. The app will not start on Ubuntu 20.04 or Debian 11, which only ship WebKitGTK 4.0.
